detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Alternative Centres of Power (Syllabus Core):
(C), (A), (D), (B)

Detailed Context:
Chronology of European Union accession rounds:
1. (C) Finland: Joined the EU on 1 January 1995 (Fourth Enlargement along with Austria and Sweden).
2. (A) Poland: Joined the EU on 1 May 2004 (Fifth Enlargement of 10 Central and Eastern European states).
3. (D) Romania: Joined the EU on 1 January 2007 (along with Bulgaria).
4. (B) Croatia: Joined the EU on 1 July 2013 as its 28th member state.
Corre

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

(A) Unification of Germany
(B) Lisbon Treaty came into force
(C) Greece joins the European Community (EC)
(D) Schengen Agreement abolishes border controls among the EC members

List-II (Year)
(I) 1985
(II) 1990
(III) 1981
(IV) 2009

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 4: Alternative Centres of Power, 'Timeline of European Integration', p. 55): (A) Unification of Germany took place in October 1990 (Match II). (B) The Treaty of Lisbon came into force in December 2009 (Match IV). (C) Greece joined the EC in January 1981 (Match III). (D) Schengen Agreement on the abolition of border controls was signed in June 1985 (Match I). Matching: (A)-(II), (B)-(IV), (C)-(III), (D)-(I).
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
